description: This file defines the MembershipTableSnapshot class, which manages snapshots of the membership state in Orleans runtime, including versioning, entries, and status checks.

classes.name: MembershipTableSnapshot
classes.description: Immutable class representing a snapshot of the membership table, including version, entries, and methods for updating and querying status.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new snapshot from the provided membership table data.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the snapshot based on new table data or another snapshot, producing a new snapshot instance.

methods.name: PreserveIAmAliveTime
methods.description: Ensures the maximum IAmAliveTime is retained for a given entry, preserving liveness info.

methods.name: GetSiloStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of a specified silo, considering direct entries and successors.

methods.name: IsSuccessorTo
methods.description: Determines if the current snapshot is a successor to another snapshot based on version and entry times.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the snapshot, including version and silo entries.
